1479-3756-8293.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

116-512-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4881-6909-7223-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7223-8200.easyPrerequisites: Stalactite Dagger is attached to Carnage.
4881-6909-7223-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

2018-8095--73.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
2018-8095--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.

 Resolve the Narce Talisman trigger by paying {3}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
